contributions.claim: Introduces OLMoE, a fully open sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model.
Releases the model weights, training data, code, and logs.
Defines and analyzes routing properties, reporting high specialization in the model.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe novel findings on MoE training and new routing properties, alongside a fully open release.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that OLMoE models outperform available models with similar active-parameter counts and surpass Llama2-13B-Chat and DeepSeekMoE-16B.
The authors report high specialization under their analyzed routing properties.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper introduces a fully open sparse-MoE language model.
OLMoE-1B-7B contains 7B total parameters but uses 1B per token; it is pretrained on 5T tokens and adapted into an instruction model.
The authors report strong comparisons against similar-active-parameter and larger models, then present MoE-training findings and routing analysis.
The work releases weights, data, code, and logs.

source_observation.claim: The abstract pairs a concrete active-parameter claim with broad comparison targets and identifies the released artifacts.

lessons.interpretation: This links efficiency, comparative positioning, and inspectability in a compact contribution narrative.
lessons.application: Authors of a systems paper could state total versus per-input compute, name comparison targets, and enumerate the artifacts needed to inspect the result.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when active parameters do not meaningfully represent the relevant cost or when artifact release is restricted.

unknowns: The abstract does not state an explicit problem or limitation in prior approaches.
The reported comparisons do not specify datasets, metrics, evaluation settings, or statistical details.
The routing analysis does not define the properties or quantify specialization.
